# Pull request

Replace the guidance under each heading.

## What

Which desks, files, or behaviors this changes.

## Why

The issue this closes, and the outcome we need.

## How tested

Commands run, or why there is no automated test yet.

## Data safety

Confirm every item.

- [ ] No passwords, tokens, API keys, or private keys.
- [ ] No account, card, bank, brokerage, mortgage, or credit data.
- [ ] No Gmail or WhatsApp message content.
- [ ] No personal contact details.
- [ ] No agent private memory or conversation exports.
- [ ] CI checks `secret-scan`, `lint`, and `tests` are green.
- [ ] This is a proposal. Tishan approves before merge.
